notes: Google example 20050 is not six digits. Do not guess its missing digit or autocorrect user data.
Current official six-digit example conflicts with prefixed and alphanumeric Google test values. Historical transition dates were not established.
Google example 1001 is not five digits. Do not infer which missing digit a user intended.
UPU prints digit 0 in RH6 0HP; Google RH6 OHP uses letter O. Preserve both source records without autocorrecting submitted addresses.
Korea Post describes the five-digit system introduced 2015-08-01. Google six-digit examples are retained as historical conflicts. Leading zero in 06043 is significant.
Dated 2013 UPU reference supplies five-digit values; old Lima/Callao district labels are not valid five-digit examples.

The dated 2004 UPU sheet says two spaces but visually prints single-space examples. The pinned CommerceGuys pattern accepts at most one space. No current national scheme, spacing rule or requiredness was verified; do not relax the pattern or present historical examples as current hints.

policy: Keep original Google examples and conflict classification unchanged.
Validate separately attributed examples against unchanged pinned postal patterns before offering display hints.
Never automatically rewrite submitted postal values from examples.
A historical document and a fetched current page do not establish nationwide provider, delivery, legal or publication acceptance.
scope: Separately sourced postcode examples for known raw-source conflicts; not a national address dataset or publication approval.
